text.ms:
1. Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah Hakmilik Strata
(Penetapan Pihak Berkuasa Berkanun) (Wilayah Persekutuan
Kuala Lumpur) 2021.

Pihak berkuasa berkanun

2. Pihak berkuasa berkanun bagi maksud Akta hendaklah sebagaimana yang
dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL
[Kaedah 2]

PIHAK BERKUASA BERKANUN

1. Datuk Bandar Kuala Lumpur

2. Perbadanan Pembangunan Kampong Bharu

3. Pesuruhjaya Tanah Persekutuan

Dibuat 28 Jun 2021
[PTG/WP(S).100-2/19jld3; PN(PU2)433/IX]

TAN SRI DATO' HAJI MAHIADDIN BIN HAJI MD YASIN
Perdana Menteri

STRATA TITLES ACT 1985

STRATA TITLES (PRESCRIPTION OF STATUTORY AUTHORITY)
(FEDERAL TERRITORY OF KUALA LUMPUR) RULES 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraphs 23H(2)(b) and 81(1)(e) of the
Strata Titles Act 1985 [ Act 318 ] read together with subsection 5(5),
the Minister makes the following rules:

Citation
1. These rules may be cited as the Strata Titles (Prescription of
Statutory Authority) (Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur) Rules 2021.

Statutory authority
2. The statutory authorit y for the purposes of the Act  shall be as specified in the
Schedule.

SCHEDULE
[Rule 2]

STATUTORY AUTHORITY

1. Commissioner of the City of Kuala Lumpur

2. Kampong Bharu Development Corporation

3. Federal Lands Commissioner

Made 28 June 2021
[PTG/WP(S).100-2/19jld3; PN(PU2)433/IX]

TAN SRI DATO' HAJI MAHIADDIN BIN HAJI MD YASIN
Prime Minister
